sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed a broken sub-table filter (STF) input selector used in 14 places across the script (`input[type="text"]` instead of the STF input's actual `type="search"`, forced by `_hardenFilterInputAgainstAutofill()`). This silently made every STF-active check inert — the per-sub-table `<h3>` "Clear all filters" button never appeared while only an STF filter was active, the "Clear ALL filters" bulk button never cleared STF inputs, and the internal re-apply-after-render pass never fired at all.

Fixed the CAA/EAA "big picture" image stripe and its per-sub-table count badge reverting to the full, unfiltered set after sorting a column on a multi-table page (e.g. release-group "Show all Releases") while a sub-table filter (STF) was active. The sort's full re-render now correctly starts each STF-filtered-out row's image wrapper hidden, and the row-count/highlighting reapply now runs synchronously as part of that same render instead of via a debounced, dead-selector code path — so the stripe/badge never visibly revert in the first place. The global, page-wide CAA/EAA toggle-button count intentionally still shows the unfiltered total regardless of any STF filter, matching existing behavior.

Fixed clearing a sub-table filter (STF) after a column sort leaving the table permanently stuck showing only the previously-filtered rows, with stale row counts and stale highlighting, and no way to get back to the full row set. Root cause: the first render of a multi-table page inserted its row elements by direct reference rather than by clone, so STF's own row-hiding markers leaked permanently into the canonical row data the moment a later re-render (e.g. a sort) rebuilt the table from it. Row insertion on first render now clones, matching how every subsequent filter/sort re-render already worked.
